text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hi, Trainer! You're invited to a party. 
You definitely have to come!
choice_data_list:
Wait, what's gotten into you all of a 
sudden?
Huh, what's with this all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Fufu, actually, just the other day—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Well then, got the cosmetics I was looking 
for, so time to grab tea, catch a movie—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "Heeeey! Heaaaart!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey Taiki! What a coincidence. Are you 
shopping? Or hopping around cafes?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I came to buy ingredients for the 
barbecue, YES! The selection at this 
supermarket is VERY good, YES!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
A barbecue! Sounds lovely. Back in my 
academy days, our instructor would host 
them for us quite often.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
He was from Memphis, so his dry-rub pork 
ribs were absolutely exquisite—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wow! Memphis style!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
A totally different charm from my cowgirl 
style! I'm super intrigued...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I like Texas style too. Even though it's 
all called barbecue, each region has its 
own unique flavor.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah, for some reason, it's making me want 
to have a barbecue for the first time in a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Taiki-san.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm probably thinking the same thing 
as Heart.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, perfect! You catch on quick! Let's 
go gather the ingredients right away!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"—And so, we thought since we're doing 
this, we might as well enjoy all kinds of 
different barbecue styles."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's truly amazing. With that much, 
we won't run out of ingredients even if we 
invite dozens of people♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, if there's someone you want to 
invite, go ahead and ask them! Let's make 
it a fun party for everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz...*)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's from Taiki-san.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hello? Is something wrong? Everything's 
all good on my end... Huh? Extra? Meat? 
That much?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, I know I did invite a lot of 
people, but... Ah, w-wait, Taiki-san!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Good news, Trainer. More meat is on the 
way. So much that I'm not even sure if all 
the guests combined can finish it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I wonder... If I take off the limiter and 
just enjoy myself, I might be able to 
finish it, but—
choice_data_list:
Why not just make it open to everyone at 
the academy?
Go ahead and eat as much as you want.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Good idea! It'll be a great way to show 
our gratitude to the staff and teachers 
who look after us every day!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, though it turned out much larger 
in scale than originally planned, the 
barbecue party concluded to great acclaim.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Are you sure? I might end up eating 
quite a lot, though.
choice_data_list:
At times like this, whoever enjoys it the 
most wins!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
So true! Since it's come to this, I'm 
gonna enjoy it with all my might, so make 
sure you eat your fill too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Daring Heart thoroughly 
enjoyed savoring regional barbecues from 
all across America.
